purpose: Teach: 立国/徘徊/潜む/具現/平衡/肥大/抱負/修業

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、技術立国の医療版を医療チームで目指します
lines.en: Ren, we're aiming to build a tech-forward version of medicine within our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady eye contact. Speaks as someone laying out a vision without fanfare. Warm but professional. Each word lands with quiet intention.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、認知症患者の徘徊対策を医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Yes — we're strengthening our approach to preventing wandering in dementia patients as a team priority.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Patient, unhurried. The tone of someone who's explained this before and means it each time. Genuine care underneath the clinical frame.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 体内に潜む癌細胞を医療チームで早期発見します、先生
lines.en: We're aiming to detect cancer cells lurking in the body early on — as a team approach, sensei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful phrasing. Slightly formal register — showing respect. Genuine enthusiasm tempered by awareness of the weight of what's being discussed. Seeking her affirmation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療理念を具現する病院作りを目指します
lines.en: Yes — we're working toward building a hospital that embodies our medical philosophy.
lines.style: Settled, reflective tone. Not rushed. She's thought about this deeply. Speaking as someone who's invested in the answer, not just delivering it. Slight warmth beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 平衡感覚障害の検査を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does balance-disorder testing, doesn't it, sensei? I've noticed that.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not interrogation. Respectful curiosity. The phrasing shows he's been paying attention. Soft delivery — not pushy, genuinely wondering. Seeking connection through noticing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心臓肥大の早期治療を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes — we're advancing early treatment for cardiac enlargement within our medical team.
lines.style: Steady, assured. She's moving through priorities. Clinical but not cold. The rhythm suggests experience and care happening simultaneously. Brief, because the work speaks for itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 若い研修医の抱負を、貴院、応援されてますね、先生
lines.en: I've seen how your hospital supports the aspirations of young resident physicians — that's impressive, sensei.
lines.style: Genuine compliment delivered quietly. Not flattering — observant. Shows he's watched how she treats her junior staff. Respectful distance maintained, but real appreciation in his voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、外科医の修業を医療チームで支えます
lines.en: Yes — we're supporting surgical residents through their training as a team commitment.
lines.style: Warm closure. Slight softening at the edges — she's speaking about something close to her. Still professional, but the personal stake shows. A beat of quiet pride at the end.
